why_this_pilot_exists.summary: in the v16 sealed confirmation batch all 32 repair retries were one class (declared_fact_missing_from_rendered_answer), each missing exactly one registered required literal, and the first prompt never stated that the declared strings must appear inside cause or fix while the renderer enforced exactly that
why_this_pilot_exists.hypothesis_h1: stating the literal-placement rule in the first prompt raises first-attempt acceptance from the v16 reference 13 of 45 samples (28.9 percent) to at least 70 percent, cutting the retry tax without touching any acceptance condition

added: one sentence in the first prompt, byte-identical for every arm: every string listed in "facts" must appear verbatim inside "cause" or "fix", because the host builds the rendered line from those two fields only, and all of them must be present at the same time as the 160 character bound
unchanged: the renderer (experiments/runners/openai_agents_structured_final_v16.py, sha256 22fa96a53c5aff5e372c4ef88787165e9e1f13e671b7ed0bafe5db2e2051612a) is imported unchanged and stays the final-answer path and the only validator
the four frozen strict-track conditions on the rendered line: registered required facts present, frozen regex full match, single line with the contract prefix, at most 160 characters
the retry budget (at most one billed retry per sample), the retry diagnostic text, and the rule that every request is charged to its arm
the summary cap of two per sample and the rule that summary requests are charged to their arm
the read-only tool set, the six read calls, the request metering and the cache metering
instrumentation_added_for_recording_only: per sample: first_reject_class, first_candidate_line, first_declared_facts, first_missing_required_literals
per sample: first_attempt_accepted (boolean) so the compliance rate is computable without inference
host_configuration_diff_against_v16.does_not_mean: recording extra fields changes no decision, no acceptance and no number; it only removes the inference gap that this round had to close by reading retry diagnostics

condition_by_condition.registered required facts present in the: unchanged; the renderer's declared-facts check is an additional host condition and is also unchanged, so a proposal that the strict track rejects is still rejected
condition_by_condition.at most 160 characters: unchanged; the bound is not relaxed and the prompt repeats it
condition_by_condition.retry budget and charging: unchanged; retries stay billed to their arm

no_relaxation_check.statement: this configuration adds a requirement to the prompt and nothing else; it cannot accept an answer the v16 strict track would have rejected, and it removes no evidence condition

matrix.task_set: the three v16 development tasks, taken from the v16 registry with ACTIVE=development

budget_arithmetic.probe: one separate capability request before the pilot, counted separately, failing closed

decision_line.pass_and_continue_to_task_shape_and_conf: first_attempt_accepted at least 70 percent of samples overall AND every arm's strict track at least the baseline's AND zero render failures AND zero truncations AND retries at most 4 of 9 samples
decision_line.report_and_ask_before_continuing: first_attempt_accepted between 50 and 70 percent, or retries between 5 and 6 of 9 samples, with quality intact
decision_line.stop_and_redesign: first_attempt_accepted below 50 percent, or any arm's strict track below the baseline's, or any sample failing the strict track, or any render failure
decision_line.note: the decision is about the retry tax only; this pilot decides nothing about savings, and its savings numbers are not citable

report_requirements: first-attempt acceptance rate overall and per arm, against the v16 reference of 28.9 percent
retry count per arm and retry tokens per arm, against the v16 numbers 38161 / 33374 / 38153
the strict track per task and per arm, with the four conditions reported separately
the reject-class decomposition from the new instrumentation, with the missing literals named, so the root cause stays checkable
requests used against the cap, cache fields present or unknown, dollar cost with the cache split and the off-peak status
complete provider token totals per arm, with summary tokens charged
an explicit statement of what this pilot cannot show
cannot_show: any saving claim: one repeat, three development tasks that took part in building this host configuration, and no confirmation
quality equivalence in general: only that the strict track was not below the baseline on these nine samples
that the retry tax generalises away: nine samples bound the compliance rate loosely
anything about other hosts or other host configurations
stop_conditions: request cap reached -> stop, keep the partial directory, and never use resume to bypass the budget
any arm's strict track below the baseline's -> stop and report, do not add samples
any sample failing the strict track -> stop and report
probe failure -> stop before the pilot and report
missing cache fields -> record unknown, never zero, and keep the totals null where they are unknown
note_on_scope: the sealed confirmation candidates are spent; this pilot runs on the development set by design, and any later confirmation needs a new sealed task set chosen under the pre-registered shape criteria
